limitations: Synthetic body configurations are not real people; no RGB detector assessment in the procedural benchmark.
The rendered walking clip is reused development evidence; its proxy rig points differ from anatomical landmarks.
Foot/palm rotations and foot sliding remain essentially unchanged; occlusion recovery improves only slightly.
Averaged synthetic uncertainty radius is conservative; coverage is not a hardware safety guarantee.
No learned cross-view features, long-term multi-hypothesis posterior or multi-person identity tracker.
Online timing uses a host exposure proxy, not physical sensor exposure; does not achieve 24 Hz.
New references worsen fixed-controller G1 dynamic imitation despite better visual metrics; no default control promotion.
All G1 tests are offline simulation with fixed injected delay, not the calibrated online gate or physical hardware.
